author: ThioJoe
description:
This is a game changer 🤔

* The GitHub Page: https://github.com/ThioJoe/Thio-Universal-Agent

I've always wondered why tech companies weren't working on AI that could actually use your computer in a way like we do. The ability to see and click around, therefore being able to control any app. There are AI agents out there but they seem to all rely on using shell commands, or are just for use within a web browser. But I want something that works with your whole computer. So I made it myself. I call it "Thio's Universal Agent", and it lets you use the AI API of your choice to control your computer in a way not possible before.
